task: FE-70 / FV2-011 — Flutter Design V2 screen viewer audio controls
summary: Aligned viewer mute and gain controls across desktop and compact Flutter layouts while keeping per-stream gain adjustment available on Android.

checks.name: Focused audio control widget tests
checks.observation: Test-first regression exposed that the compact/desktop percent readout did not exist. The first layout iteration then caught a compact unbounded-width Row and a collapsed desktop toolbar. Fixed toolbar geometry is 40 px desktop and 48 px compact inside the 56 px viewer strip; mute and 0–200% gain remain available, and deafen disables both controls.

checks.name: Spec traceability verifier
checks.observation: PowerShell Core is unavailable. Manual Ruby traceability validation passed: all 39 approved requirements are referenced, all 69 task IDs are unique, and no dependencies dangle.

checks.name: Windows build, matched screenshots, and platform runtime acceptance
checks.observation: Geometry/widget tests and Android/macOS Debug builds do not prove screenshot parity or platform runtime behavior. The already-open macOS app was not restarted.

limitations: Audio state ownership, LiveKit lifecycle, and track handling are unchanged.
Production web hides the gain slider at compact widths; Flutter keeps it visible on Android to preserve the requested per-stream volume adjustment.
Windows build, paired screenshots, and Android/macOS/Windows runtime visual acceptance remain open.
